## Task - 2
```{r}
count_above <- function(data,count,cutoff){ #assigns the function
  count_above
  
  for (i in 1:length(count)){ #defines what the function is doing 
    if(count[i] > cutoff){
      count<- count+1 #for instance, the function with take the count and add 1 to it 
    }
  }
  return(count) #This is what the code will give you when ran 
}
```
How many flowers have a seapl length greater than 6 cm in the iris dataset?
```{r}

count_above(iris, iris$Sepal.Length, 6)

```
How many cars have a value greater than or equal to 150 disp in the mtcars dataset?
```{r}

count_above(mtcars, mtcars$disp, 150)
```
